w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Christian to Ethan, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Granary on empty shelves — 16,640 of 20,000 kcal."
A cart-driver with flour on their sleeves waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the fifth hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.
⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,220 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
